text:
Ana - PM: Heads up — got a bundle of integration asks from Support/Sales after last week's enterprise review. Need quick triage and prioritization. TL;DR: Terraform provider gaps, JS SDK hooks for streaming, Python SDK async bug, and SSO/SCIM user sync feature requests.

Jordan (AE): Customer A (healthcare) wants SCIM full-sync + delta sync and SCIM group sync. High compliance need, will push contract conditional on roadmap.

Deepa S: Support ticket #4521 — customer sees duplicate users when SCIM push hits our API intermittently. Repro steps in thread: 1) create user in IdP 2) push -> 409/200 race 3) duplicate entry. They want server-side idempotency and stronger conflict handling.

Mike R: Quick take from eng: Terraform provider missing `redwood_inference_service` resource for Dedicated. ETA vary: small change for provider schema (~2d), but needs backend API to expose service-binding endpoints (~1w) and e2e tests.

Sasha P: For SSO/SCIM: we need to add `external_id` canonicalization and a reconcile API. Also network-level concerns for Private customers (VPC/proxy) — will need docs + test harness.

Jordan (AE): Customer B (fintech) wants JS SDK streaming hooks to attach to custom operators (they want to capture token-level deltas). Priority: P2 for them but P1 if we want the marketplace listing.

Ana - PM: Let's agree on tagging and immediate next steps. Proposed tags: `integration/sdk`, `area:auth`, `priority:customer`, `pm:ana`, `type:backlog`. Any objections?

Deepa S: +1 for tags. Add `bug:scim` to the support ticket.

Mike R: Add `deps:backend-api` and `effort:small|medium|large` — I'll estimate properly if we create tickets.

Sasha P: Also `private-deploy` for customers behind VPC, and `compliance:required` for healthcare/finance.

Ana - PM: OK I'll create epics: 1) SCIM reliability & full/delta sync (compliance customers) 2) Terraform provider parity 3) SDK streaming hooks + Python async fix. We should scope MVPs: SCIM MVP = idempotent writes + group sync endpoint + tests. Terraform MVP = basic service resource + docs. SDK MVP = streaming callbacks + a patch for async bug.

Jordan (AE): Please mark SCIM epic as `priority:customer` and include expected delivery window in the ticket so I can update the contracts team. Customer A needs ETA within 2 weeks or they escalate.

triage-bot: created issue RW-ISSUE-7891 (SCIM reliability epic) and RW-ISSUE-7892 (Terraform provider parity) and RW-ISSUE-7893 (SDK streaming + python async). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-ISSUE-7891

Ana - PM: Mike — can you drop rough T-shirt sizes inline here? Helps prioritize across other work.

Mike R: SCIM reliability = Large (backend + reconciliation + tests)
Terraform provider = Medium (provider changes + API endpoint)
SDK streaming + Python async = Small (sdk changes + unit tests + patch)

Deepa S: Can we also add regression alerting to Redwood Console for SCIM flows? If a sync fails x times, create a support incident flag.

Sasha P: Good call. Add `monitoring:scim` to the SCIM epic and link to the console alerting playbook. I'll schedule a short runbook update.

Ana - PM: Action items I'll own: create epics (done by bot), set tags as discussed, draft scope + launch criteria for each MVP. Mike to provide dev estimates and PR owners by EOD tomorrow. Sasha to draft runbook + private deploy notes. Jordan/Deepa keep customer comms warm.

Jordan (AE): I'll update Customer A & B with tentative plan and note that we prioritized SCIM as highest-risk.

Mike R: Will post estimates by 2026-04-02 EOD.

Ana - PM: Thanks all. If no objections I'll move these epics into the 'committed backlog' lane. :thumbsup:

Sasha P: :thumbsup:

Deepa S: :thumbsup: 

Jordan (AE): ack

Ana - PM: Closing thread — will follow up with Jira links and a triage summary doc.
